# Ranunculus fucoides Freyn

First published in M.Willkomm & J.M.C.Lange, Prodr. Fl. Hispan. 3: 912 (1880)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is W. & Central Medit. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
